faq.q: What have houses in Pacific Douglas sold for?

items.t: Pacific Douglas: 40 houses sold at a median of $1,593,000, with the middle half between $1,459,500 and $1,710,500. The median house took 21 days to sell and closed at 97.3% of list.

34 townhomes sold in Pacific Douglas at a median of $825,000 (middle half $748,875 to $873,000). A typical townhome in Pacific Douglas spent 19 days on the market and closed at 97.2% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Pacific Douglas compares with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock

items.t: Houses in Pacific Douglas have the 5th highest median of 8 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas, $1,593,000. King George Corridor is lowest at $1,345,000 and Elgin Chantrell highest at $2,280,000. White Rock ($1,565,000) sits just below and Crescent Beach and Ocean Park ($1,745,000) sits just above.

Of 8 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Pacific Douglas ranks 5th highest at $825,000; the range is $776,000 (King George Corridor) to $1,242,500 (Elgin Chantrell). Crescent Beach and Ocean Park ($824,000) sits just below and Grandview ($829,900) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Pacific Douglas (median 2018) and houses the oldest (median 2013), a gap of 5 years.
